blocks.text: Imagine sitting in the yard on a fine afternoon, chatting with friends at leisure. Coffee on the table, you and your friends sit on the rocker, enjoying the breeze and sunshine. So relaxing! All you need is this rocking bistro set.

Making by selected steel, the rockers are sturdy enough. Also the better balanced design is equipped to improve your sitting experience. The breathable textilene fabric seat won't let you feel any of uncomfortable.
Featuring a small table, you can put your handphone or cups of tea on it. Tempered glass on the table adds more convenience to clean if any drinks drops on it.

Also, the 3 piece bistro set comes with a simple chic looking, which making it suitable for any decor style for your patio, yard, poolside, balcony and front porch. Just bring it your home and start relaxing your outdoor leisure time!

items.label: Sturdy and Long-lasting Construction
items.value: This 3 pieces patio sets cover made of powder coated solid steel frame has good strength and stability, high weather resistance, UV resistance and rust. The three-legged round table makes the table more solid and stable.

items.label: Upgraded Breathable Fabric
items.value: Textilene fabric for the chair which is breathable and cool, you will not feel hot even in Summer, and is much more comfortable than rattan seats. The material is tear and weather resistance, easy to clean.

items.label: Comfortable and Convenient
items.value: The outdoor patio chair is exceptionally comfortable, offering a relaxing experience. The armrest fits the arm radian, bringing you unlimited relaxation and enjoyment.

items.label: Modern and Simple Style
items.value: This patio furniture sets are suitable for any environment such as poolside, garden, yard, porch or balcony, etc. Since the materials are light, you can easily move them as you like.

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: Our patio set comes equipped with all parts , necessary tools and instructions are cleverly packed into one box for easy assembly.We've optimized the installation steps to a minimalist mode, which should only take you 15-30 minutes.
